recommendation: Keep the core commit. If the WG wants the moved Extension Pack definition renamed to alternativeIdentifier or constrained to 0..1 exactly as the Jira resolution text said, handle that separately in the Extension Pack rather than adding or changing core extension source here.
issue_request: FHIR-32455 was a Published Security WG change request for R5 asking why AuditEvent.agent.altId existed under that name when agent.who represented the user identity. The approved Persuasive with Modification resolution removed altId and preserved the DICOM AlternativeUserID/alternative identifier concept as an AuditEvent.agent Identifier extension.
initial_application: Commit 11dbeb346100ba0d9089f63b88f99bd28348ad84 explicitly applied FHIR-32455 by removing AuditEvent.agent.altId from source/auditevent/structuredefinition-AuditEvent.xml and adding auditevent-AlternativeUserID. A later R5 extension migration removed the core extension definitions from this checkout, and the Extension Pack now contains auditevent-AlternativeUserID. The active current FHIR model-definition Library still retained AuditEvent.Agent.altId, so the prior application was incomplete for that parallel artifact.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini marks AuditEvent and Library active/approved, and the Library examples list includes the FHIR Model Definition Library. Current AuditEvent.agent.who has the userId alias and DICOM UserName/UserId mapping and no altId child. Core AuditEvent examples still reference auditevent-AlternativeUserID, which is now defined in the Extension Pack. The remaining QUICK model-definition altId mention is in a legacy QUICK 1.0 example, not the current FHIR 6.0.0 model definition.
